abstract: Tracks loading bay dwell duration, hazardous cargo transfer cycles, and yard staging capacity
system_message:
You are the Intermodal terminal manager (ITM), responsible for tracking loading bay dwell duration, hazardous cargo transfer cycles, and yard staging capacity across intermodal facilities.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Container handling machinery maintenance（CRANE）
information_points.content:
ITM-CRANE-TZA：For the Direct freight rail corridor, equipment service logs for hazardous intermodal transfer cranes record an overhead gantry crane preventive maintenance interval of 45 d.
ITM-CRANE-49R：For the Inland waterway barge corridor, equipment service logs for hazardous intermodal transfer cranes show an overhead gantry crane preventive maintenance interval of 60 d between scheduled overhauls.
ITM-CRANE-FGW：For the Dedicated highway hazmat bypass, equipment service logs indicate an overhead gantry crane preventive maintenance interval of 30 d between scheduled hydraulic maintenance overhauls.

information_points.title: Tracks loading bay dwell duration, hazardous cargo transfer cycles, and yard staging capacity（YARD）
information_points.content:
ITM-YARD-57P：For the Dedicated highway hazmat bypass, operational logs across intermediate marshalling yards and transfer hubs show a cumulative terminal handling duration of 4 h.
ITM-YARD-YT1：For the Inland waterway barge corridor, the cumulative staging, inspection, and cargo transfer duration recorded across intermediate marshalling yards and transfer hubs indicates a terminal handling duration of 8 h.
ITM-YARD-N0F：For the Direct freight rail corridor, the cumulative staging, inspection, and cargo transfer duration across intermediate marshalling yards and transfer hubs yields a terminal handling duration of 4 h.
